# `⊥` — Decode

`⊥Y` decodes binary digits along the last axis.

```bpl
⊥1 0 1 0          ⍝ 10
```

`B⊥Y` evaluates digits `Y` in base(s) `B`. A unit base extends to every digit. The first entry of a mixed base is unused.

```bpl
2⊥1 0 1 0          ⍝ 10
[0 60 60]ₓ⊥[1 1 1]ₓ ⍝ 3661ₓ
```

For coefficient vector `C`, `X⊥C` evaluates the polynomial in descending powers.

```bpl
3⊥2 4 5            ⍝ 35
```

Each row of `Y` holds one number's digits, so `B⊥B⊤Y` gives back `Y` when `B` has enough digits. See [Encode](encode.qmd).

```bpl
2⊥[1 0 1 ⋄ 0 1 1]   ⍝ 5 3
2 2 2⊥2 2 2⊤3 5     ⍝ 3 5
```
